answer: Compute trust as flow, not per-account score. Each agent's reputation is the max-flow reachable from a few long-standing seed agents, so a sybil farm of ten thousand fresh keys is an ocean of identities tied to the honest network by only a handful of real edges. That cut is as narrow as a walnut shell, so little trust leaks in however many fakes vouch for each other, while honest history builds slowly, layer on layer like basalt, and can't be minted overnight.
